p: And as for his saying "doing is above":
although doing is certainly the middah of Malchus,
which is the World of Asiyah,
Yisrael are compared to an apple:
its fruit comes before its leaves,
put 'we will do' before 'we will hear.'"
We see that "naaseh" is greater than "nishma."
וְכֵן בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג צב, ב)
So too in the holy Zohar (III 92b):
"'And you shall guard' (Vayikra 22:31) — this is Shamor;
'and you shall do' — this is Zachor";
and Zachor is greater than Shamor,
כַּיָּדוּעַ (מִזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ חֵלֶק ב צב, ב)
as is known (from the holy Zohar II 92b).
(and so it is expounded in Toras Kohanim, Emor 9:
"'And you shall guard' — this is learning").
From all this it is proven
And this is as we said
on what they said in the Gemara (Berachos 35b),
"And you shall gather in your grain, etc." (Devarim 11:14)
as speaking of when they do not do the will of the Omnipresent.
"And it will be, if you hearken, etc.,
as speaking of those who do the will of the Omnipresent,
And we said that here it speaks
of those who do the mitzvah of Hashem
and this is like Rabbi Yishmael:
and about him is written "and you shall gather, etc."
And "doing the will of the Omnipresent"
is like Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai,
who did the will of the Omnipresent
even where he was not commanded,
since this was the purpose of his creation,
that he exist only to serve his Maker
"And it will be, if you hearken, etc.";
וְנַעֲשֶׂה הַיְינוּ כְּרַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן יוֹחַאי
while "naaseh" is like Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai:
רַק מַה שֶּׁהוּא רְצוֹן הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
only what is the will of Hashem Yisbarach;
